question: If Gate B holds at the frozen point P0 = (b, theta, gamma) = (0, 120 deg, 0), does the symmetric-gapped chiral phase persist on an open neighbourhood in (b, theta, gamma), so that P1/P2 only need to select a region?
verdict_scope: Only exact free / one-site / IR prechecks were computed. No QMC was launched.

preregistration.coordinates: (b, theta in degrees, gamma): filter f_b = 1 - ccc + b sss; kinetic d_i = sum_j alpha_ij sin p_j + sum_j beta_ij(theta, gamma)(cos p_j - 1) + axis hops (gamma, -gamma)
preregistration.run_condition: Start only after Gate B reaches CONDITIONAL at P0 under TFPT.FULL.PROCESS.01 G1-G5, including the round-56 equilibration rule and SPG.BUDGET.01. Use the same g, beta, dtau, cells, estimators and >= 2 independent chains per point. Reproduce the free reference (prechecks UC7) first.
preregistration.reporting: Report g and g_mirror = g (1 + b)^4 and g* = g (9/8 + b^2/8)^2 separately; the theta points change only the mirror frame.
preregistration.decision_rule: UNIVERSAL_CANDIDATE if all five points pass the same Gate-B criteria. FINE_TUNED if P0 passes and at least one neighbour fails cleanly, with a resolved sign budget and equilibration. UNDECIDED if any point is sign- or feasibility-limited. No interpolation between outcomes.
preregistration.not_allowed: No larger scan before this decision. No retuning of the design points after data are seen.

arms.A_fixed_coupling: same microscopic g at all five points (what does the same fundamental parameter do in different runtime realisations?)
arms.B_matched_mirror_coupling: g(b) = g0/(1+b)^4 so that g(b)(1+b)^4 = g_mirror(P0): P_b+ 0.4096 g0, P_b- 3.1605 g0 (decisive for the universality question)

amendment_1.velocities: Gamma and mirror Weyl speeds are exactly 1 at every design point (V_Gamma = I, V_P orthogonal); report them, no renormalisation needed
amendment_1.decision_rule_update: UNIVERSAL_CANDIDATE requires arm B to pass at all five points; arm A is reported separately and does not decide universality
amendment_1.feasibility_note: arm B at P_b- needs 3.16 g0; if g0 lies near the sign-limited region the point may be UNDECIDED (record R and the sign budget)

mathematical_verdict: ALL_DESIGN_POINTS_MINIMALLY_DOUBLED; MIRROR_AT_P; LOCAL_SO11_CONDITION_HOLDS_UP_TO_G_STAR_RESCALING; MIRROR_WEIGHT_(1+b)^4; IR_IDENTICAL; ARM_B_MATCHED_MIRROR_COUPLING_ADDED; UNIT_WEYL_SPEEDS
summary_de: Vorregistrierter Universalitaetstest: fuenf Punkte (b = +-0.25; theta = 100/140 Grad) um den eingefrorenen Punkt. Alle sind minimal verdoppelt, der Spiegel sitzt bei P, die lokale so(11)-Bedingung gilt bis auf g* = g (9/8 + b^2/8)^2, und das IR ist identisch. Der Spiegel sieht den Quartic mit Gewicht (1+b)^4 (2,44 bzw. 0,32). Kein QMC gestartet: Gate B fuer P0 ist offen.
resolved: Frozen design and decision rule; exact free reference energies for validation.
